p.i: Buntslovius legatus cum collegis in Frisia, de libertate Frif. populo traditum: & actio d
§ Actiones Buntslovij. Colloquia inter p[?] [?]actio cum Ioanne Bavaro, Comite Hollandiae [?] compositio inter omnes Frisios Groninga.

main_text.p: * Kenonis expeditio in Frisiâ Occiduâ. Fœdus Groning. cum Langowoldijs, Fredowoldijs Hummerzijs & Oftopagicis: item aliud cum Hunesgonijs & Fivelgonijs. † Aliud fœdus cum ijsdem pro tuenda libertate. Groninga cum tota factione Vetcoperorum proscripta a Sigismundo Imp. ‡ Expeditio Foec. Fil. Vcconis in Frisiam Occiduam. Colloquia inter factiones de pace frustranea. Fœderis repetitio inter Groning. & vicinos. Civitas episcopo Blanchemio sacramentum dicit. Hoc anno nascitur Wesselus Groning. cognomento Gansfortius, quibusdam BASILIVS dictus.per eum Diploma Imp. e pace tentata. ortes de pace. Transfa-lie, &c.

page.notes: The marks *, †, ‡, § in the left column are read from the scan and may be misread. The line "V 2 | Iide[?]" is uncertain. The foot-note line beginning "§ Actiones" is partly unclear. The table cell layout is an interpretation of the printed rows. The page is the lower part of a page whose upper part is not shown. The printed marks *, †, ‡ belong to the marginal notes; no matching reference marks are visible in the shown text. Some word-fragments at the left edge are cut off by the scan edge and are not transcribed.
